title: NASA Announces the X-70, a New Experimental Aircraft
paragraphs: NASA has shown a new experimental plane called the X-70 Fractal. The news came on 4 November at an event at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The plane has a pilot on board.

NASA says it will use the X-70 for research. Scientists will test new ways to control a plane and make it move. The plane can carry up to 2,000 pounds of test equipment, and workers can change the equipment quickly.
The X-70 has not flown yet. NASA leader Jared Isaacman said the first flight should come within two years. The pictures NASA shared were made by computer, so they do not show the real plane.
